profiles.name: Intercom
profiles.why: Both bundle AI agents with chat and messaging across channels, but price very differently: Intercom charges per seat (from $19/seat/mo on Essential) plus $0.99 per Fin outcome, while Crisp's AI Agent sits inside a flat per-workspace rate that does not vary with conversation volume. That structural difference supports Intercom being a higher, usage-exposed price point relative to Crisp's flat-rate model, though neither page proves buyers choose one over the other for this reason.
profiles.discovery_reason: The buyer's closest alternative when they want chat plus AI agents and in-app messaging bundled into one tool, but at a higher price point than Crisp
profiles.one_liner: Intercom is the only helpdesk with a natively integrated AI Agent, Fin.
profiles.promise: Intercom and Fin are built together, sharing the same record, knowledge, and inbox, so every customer conversation improves the next one.
profiles.pricing: Essential $19/seat/mo (discounted from $29) + $0.99 per Fin outcome; Advanced $85/seat/mo + $0.99 per Fin outcome, includes 20 free Lite seats; Expert $132/seat/mo + $0.99 per Fin outcome, includes 50 free Lite seats; Fin alone $0.99 per outcome with no seats required and a minimum monthly commitment.
profiles.free_entry: 14-day free trial, no credit card required, includes all features, Fin, and add-ons.
profiles.icp: Customer support for individuals, startups, and small businesses (Essential); growing support teams (Advanced); large support teams (Expert).
